title: Code Geass: Nightmare of Nunnally
japaneseTitle: コードギアス ナイトメア・オブ・ナナリー
author: Gorō Taniguchi, Ichirō Ōkouchi & Takuma Tomomasa
description: After the Britannian conquest of Area 11, Nunnally Lamperouge is caught in a terrorist attack and encounters Nemo, an entity from C.C.'s realm who offers her a Geass: the power to 'read the lines of the future'. Piloting the bespoke Knightmare Frame Mark Nemo, Nunnally fights to uncover the truth of the world alongside Lelouch (Zero) and Suzaku.
